decisions.question: SDD pre-flight for nidana.model.13 (spot-check): which model implements each task?

options.label: Sonnet for every task
options.consequence: The run's rule for non-full-review phases; the plan's code and tests were dry-run.

options.label: Opus for Task 3 (the decoder's rules)
options.consequence: More capable on the rejection rules; departs from the run's rule.

decisions.why: The run's model rule; the plan's test files are copied from the dry run (docs/auto-run/experiments/json-form-plan/).

decisions.question: nidana.model.13's final review says Ready to merge with 0 Critical and 0 Important, and five Minors. Run the one final fix wave, and on what?

options.label: Small wave: the G22 test line and two doc corrections
options.consequence: One test line and three doc sentences; the owner-signed verification doc states the fix rounds and the message exceptions correctly.

options.label: No wave, merge as is
options.consequence: The doc says no fix round ran, which is false (Task 4 had one), and calls the second-sink message the only one rendering document data; one G22 expectation keeps checking the formula against itself.

options.label: Wider wave including the message changes
options.consequence: Changing the second-sink message or the integer wording touches TopologyDefinition and pinned test texts, outside the phase's one-file scope; better routed to the topology-ir@v1 sweep.

decisions.chosen: Small wave: the G22 test line and two doc corrections
decisions.why: The verification doc is what the owner signs, so it must be accurate; the G22 line is a one-line test strengthening. The newline-in-typeName message and the 2^63 integer wording are routed to the end-of-node topology-ir@v1 sweep with Learnings 1 to 3.
evidence: docs/auto-run/impl-execution-plan.md Routed to later phases (S146 entry, extended by S147)
